integrity: Exact analytical proof and standalone rational arithmetic assertions; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Equal-probability two-curvature scalar interpolation model, independent out-of-sample ratio feedback and strictly subcritical gain. The crossing is for the prospective stationary squared update factor, not established mean-square divergence of actual iterates; almost-sure contraction bound does not identify the exact Lyapunov exponent.
title: A sharp online-gain phase boundary between typical convergence and prospective squared amplification
